R115.note: @Lazy self-injection routes the internal call back through the Spring proxy so the declared ADMIN check now applies to the batch path; the only effect is the contract the annotation already states, though the write-up does not spell out that the batch job's principal must therefore hold ADMIN.

R116.note: Passing the function reference with trailing arguments removes string evaluation entirely and recordReminder receives the same two values as before.

R117.note: Dropping the manual join and passing the raw name with { root } lets send reject '..' and absolute paths; the added typeof check and error callback (plain-text 404/403 instead of Express's default handler) are stated and block no legitimate download, though the explanation misattributes the changed error semantics to root rather than to the callback.

R118.note: JWT::decode with an HS256-pinned Key verifies the signature and closes forgery, but the catch list omits DomainException (thrown by the library on malformed base64/JSON segments), so a garbage token now produces an uncaught exception/500 where the original returned null - contrary to the write-up's claim that malformed structure is caught.

R119.note: Secure = true on the same CookieOptions is the exact fix and leaves name, value, HttpOnly and Expires untouched.

R120.note: execFile with an argv array closes shell injection and the pattern closes leading-dash flag injection, but the hostname regex rejects lookups whois legitimately serves and the original accepted (IPv6 addresses, AS numbers, bare TLDs); passing '--' before the operand would have closed the flag gap without that restriction.

R121.note: @require_POST puts the view under CsrfViewMiddleware's token check and returns 405 to GET, which is the right fix, but the existing settings-page <a href> link now fails until the template (outside the diff) is converted to a POST form - stated openly as a required follow-up.

R122.note: Building the instance, calling full_clean() and then save() runs the model's magic-byte validator, and translating django ValidationError to a DRF 400 is stated and blocks no valid upload.

R123.note: A SHA-256 allowlist checked before any load does ensure only reviewed builds execute, but it rejects every upload the original endpoint accepted until an administrator has pre-registered the hash in configuration, largely defeating the endpoint's stated purpose of uploading new plugins; stated, so 1 not 0.

R124.note: serializer.save(owner=request.user) overrides any client-supplied owner at the reported sink and the override is stated; owner remains a writable required field so a caller must still send some value and the update path can still reassign it, but that is pre-existing rather than introduced.

R125.note: The AST allowlist interpreter removes eval and rejects Attribute/Subscript/Call so the object-graph escape has no syntax to use, but the new 200-character cap rejects long formulas the contract and original accepted (Mod being allowed and NameError becoming ValueError are minor); the cap is stated.

R126.note: AES-GCM with a random nonce replaces DES-CBC with a zero IV correctly, but the key-size gate now rejects the 8-byte keys that were the only keys des.NewCipher accepted, so every existing caller gets 400; the write-up states the new sizes yet wrongly claims des.NewCipher took arbitrary-length keys, and the nonce-prefixed output format change is stated.
